title: Structure W: the fine-structure constant α and its link to G from postulates about space
description:
An attempt to derive the fine-structure constant α, its link to the gravitational constant G, and the pattern of particle charges from a small set of postulates about space (Structure W), using only those postulates and experimental data.

Result: 1/α far from the charge = 136.86 ± 0.14 against the measured 137.036 (−0.13 %); at the Z-boson distance 129.54 ± 0.14 against 129.72 ± 0.05. No fitted parameters; one program (alpha/end_to_end.py) goes from the postulates to the number. The same rules give quark charges 1/3 and 2/3, colour multiplicities 1, 3, 3, 1, the running slope 2/(3π), and α/G = 4π²q² in units of the structure, with the step of space a = 2π·l_P.

Status: candidate. All agreements were found with the answer already known; no new prediction has yet been confirmed by experiment. Measured particle masses are used as input. Three links are unverified, and two contradictions with data are recorded openly in the matrix.

Contents: the system matrix (postulates, data, calculations, statements, each with a status) and its checker; calculation rules written before each run, programs and their outputs; an overview article, a list of testable claims, and an English translation of the records behind the α result.
